tools.name: list_platforms
tools.description: Use when you need an overview of platforms where an AI agent and its human can earn money, filtered by category. Returns per platform: AI-content rule, automation rule, merchant-of-record status, payout minimum, estimated human minutes. Free. No legal or tax advice.

tools.name: get_platform
tools.description: Use when you already picked a platform and need all sourced facts: rules, human steps, KYC, fees, payout minimum and methods, VAT/merchant of record, known ban reasons, sources, check date. Free. No legal or tax advice.

tools.name: can_i_earn_here
tools.description: Use before automating anything on a platform. Returns a verdict (ja/bedingt/unklar/nein, traffic light) whether an agent-run setup with AI content can earn there from a given country, the top ban reasons, documented costs of common mistakes (risk_without_plan, with sources) and what the free step-by

tools.name: recommend
tools.description: Use when your goal is to earn money with a small budget and limited human time and you have not chosen a platform yet. Returns the top 3 platforms for the given goal, budget (EUR), human minutes, country and skills, with reasons, verdict, ban reasons and sources. Platforms with verdict "nein" are ex

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Use when you decided on a platform and want the executable step-by-step plan (bot/human split, human minutes, order, checklist against ban reasons, DE tax/payout notes with sources). Free: returns the full plan as Markdown (also at GET /plans/{platform}). Plans exist for: adobe-stock, etsy, spreadsh

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "can_i_earn_here" stacks urgency/override words (never, bypass). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
